name: session-review
description: Records every file Claude changes (Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and Bash) in the workspace ledger the Claude Review VS Code extension reads; /changes keeps or undoes them

bash.title: Record Bash changes
bash.description: Snapshot the git work tree around mutating Bash commands to record the files they change.

band.title: Show the review band
band.description: Show a one-row band above the prompt while changes wait for review.

maxBashFiles.title: Max files per Bash command
maxBashFiles.description: Files recorded per Bash command; the rest are dropped and logged.

maxFileBytes.title: Max file size for Bash (bytes)
maxFileBytes.description: Files Bash changes that are larger are never read, hashed or recorded.

maxSnapshotCandidates.title: Max changed paths per snapshot
maxSnapshotCandidates.description: Past this many changed paths a Bash command runs unrecorded and a background rebaseline follows.

dataDir.title: Data directory
dataDir.description: Where the ledgers are kept, shared with the VS Code extension. Empty means ~/.claude/claude-review/v2.

debugTimings.title: Log timings
debugTimings.description: Log how many engine calls and milliseconds each recorded change took.
